items.name: Student dropout dataset
items.description: The dataset includes anonymized information related to undergraduate students who have enrolled and attended at least one semester at Tecnologico de Monterrey in Mexico from 2014 to 2020. Among the information categories available in this dataset are: -Sociodemographic information (age, gender, place of origin). -Enrollment information (program/school, region). -Academic information related to the student (previous level average, current average, periods completed). -Information associated with scores on admission tests (PAA, TOEFL, other initial evaluations). -Academic history (type of school, region, national/international, Tec system). -Student life (participation in sports, cultural, entrepreneurial activities). -Financial information (type of scholarship, percentage of scholarship).
